name: google-search
description: Google Search tools for Claude: Search Console sites, sitemaps, search analytics and URL inspection, plus Custom Search, site verification and the Indexing API (restricted to job postings and livestreams). Read-only unless you turn writes on.

allow_writes.title: Allow write tools
allow_writes.description: Expose tools that add sites or submit sitemaps. Site and sitemap deletion also need confirm=true in each call.

token_dir.title: Token directory (optional)
token_dir.description: Where OAuth tokens are stored. Leave empty for ~/.google-services-mcps.
